In [[mathematics]], specifically [[group theory]], the '''stability group'''<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Newell |first1=Martin L. |last2=Trombetti |first2=Marco |title=A local approach to stability groups |journal=Journal of Algebraic Combinatorics |pages=599–602 |doi=10.1007/s10801-024-01345-8 |volume=60 |year=2014 |issue=2|doi-access=free }}</ref> of a [[normal series|subnormal series]] is the [[automorphism group|group of automorphisms]] that act as the identity on each [[quotient group]].
